brief.zh: 感化僵尸，使之生产阳光

description.en: Solar Sages illuminate zombies, causing them to make better choices and depart, leaving behind a trail of sun.
description.zh: 阳光鼠尾草感化僵尸，使他们心甘情愿地离开，并沿路产出阳光。

chat.en: "Ommm," Solar Sage hums softly to herself. But she's not kidding anybody. We all know her mind is filled with race cars and bulldozers.
chat.zh: “嗡——嗡——”阳光鼠尾草低声吟诵着。但谁都骗不了，大家都知道她满脑子跑车和推土机。

text.zh: 一次性使用，接触到僵尸时触发
在动物和机器面前十分脆弱
